// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test data: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
// Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28; the adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Standard-library-only AST/source extraction, following logfmt-ownership-producer.go.txt.
// This never executes Loki/Pulse or computes parser/query expectations.
// From the Pulse repository root, using the unmodified pinned Loki checkout:
//
//	cp test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/json-parser-producer.go.txt /tmp/json-parser-producer.go
//	go build -o /tmp/json-parser-producer /tmp/json-parser-producer.go
//	/tmp/json-parser-producer /tmp/pulse-loki-expressions-reference/pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go /tmp/pulse-loki-expressions-reference/pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/testdata/parsers.logqltest > /tmp/json-parser.json
//	cmp /tmp/json-parser.json test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/json-parser.json
//
// Normal Elixir/Rust replay reads committed JSON, without Go or network access.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"
const parserPath = "pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go"
const enginePath = "pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/testdata/parsers.logqltest"

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func require(ok bool, message string) {
	if !ok {
		panic(message)
	}
}
func hash(data []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) }
func number(s string) int     { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); must(err); return n }
func unquote(s string) string { v, err := strconv.Unquote(s); must(err); return v }
func literal(e ast.Expr) string {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	require(ok && lit.Kind == token.STRING, "expected string literal")
	return unquote(lit.Value)
}

type selection struct {
	Purpose     string `json:"purpose"`
	SourceStart int    `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int    `json:"source_end"`
	SHA256      string `json:"sha256"`
	Raw         string `json:"raw"`
}
type source struct {
	Path       string      `json:"path"`
	SHA256     string      `json:"sha256"`
	URL        string      `json:"url"`
	Selections []selection `json:"selections"`
}

func selectLines(data []byte, first, last int, purpose string) selection {
	lines := strings.SplitAfter(string(data), "\n")
	require(first > 0 && last >= first && last <= len(lines), "invalid source range")
	raw := strings.Join(lines[first-1:last], "")
	return selection{purpose, first, last, hash([]byte(raw)), raw}
}
func loadSource(path, upstream, expectedHash string) ([]byte, source) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	must(err)
	require(hash(data) == expectedHash, "unrecognized source bytes: "+upstream)
	return data, source{Path: upstream, SHA256: hash(data), URL: "https://github.com/grafana/loki/blob/" + revision + "/" + upstream}
}
func labels(e ast.Expr) map[string]string {
	call := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	selector := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	require(selector.X.(*ast.Ident).Name == "labels", "unexpected labels package")
	out := map[string]string{}
	if selector.Sel.Name == "EmptyLabels" {
		require(len(call.Args) == 0, "unexpected EmptyLabels arguments")
		return out
	}
	require(selector.Sel.Name == "FromStrings" && len(call.Args)%2 == 0, "unsupported labels expression")
	for i := 0; i < len(call.Args); i += 2 {
		key := literal(call.Args[i])
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label")
		out[key] = literal(call.Args[i+1])
	}
	return out
}
func metadata(e ast.Expr) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	if ident, ok := e.(*ast.Ident); ok {
		require(ident.Name == "nil", "unexpected metadata identifier")
		return out
	}
	for _, field := range e.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
		pair := field.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
		key := literal(pair.Key)
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate metadata")
		out[key] = literal(pair.Value)
	}
	return out
}
func jsonPaths(e ast.Expr) map[string][]string {
	out := map[string][]string{}
	for _, field := range e.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
		pair := field.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
		key := literal(pair.Key)
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate JSON path")
		parts := []string{}
		for _, part := range pair.Value.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			parts = append(parts, literal(part))
		}
		out[key] = parts
	}
	return out
}
func extractTable(data []byte) []map[string]any {
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, parserPath, data, 0)
	must(err)
	raw := func(n ast.Node) string {
		return string(data[fset.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:fset.Position(n.End()).Offset])
	}
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || fn.Name.Name != "Test_jsonParser_Parse" {
			continue
		}
		require(fset.Position(fn.Pos()).Line == 13 && fset.Position(fn.End()).Line == 273, "unexpected function range")
		assign := fn.Body.List[0].(*ast.AssignStmt)
		require(assign.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident).Name == "tests", "expected tests table")
		table := assign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		require(len(table.Elts) == 16 && fset.Position(table.End()).Line == 247, "unexpected JSON table")
		for _, e := range table.Elts {
			item := e.(*ast.CompositeLit)
			require(len(item.Elts) == 7, "unexpected JSON table row shape")
			call := item.Elts[1].(*ast.CallExpr)
			require(raw(call.Fun) == "[]byte" && len(call.Args) == 1, "unexpected line conversion")
			s := selectLines(data, fset.Position(item.Pos()).Line, fset.Position(item.End()).Line, "complete JSON parse table row")
			hint := raw(item.Elts[5])
			require(hint == "NoParserHints()" || hint == `NewParserHint([]string{"__error__"}, nil, false, true, "")`, "unexpected parser hint")
			rows = append(rows, map[string]any{
				"name": literal(item.Elts[0]), "function": fn.Name.Name,
				"line": literal(call.Args[0]), "line_expression": raw(item.Elts[1]),
				"base_labels": labels(item.Elts[2]), "want": labels(item.Elts[3]),
				"want_json_path": jsonPaths(item.Elts[4]), "json_path_expression": raw(item.Elts[4]),
				"hint_expression": hint, "hinted": hint != "NoParserHints()",
				"structured_metadata": metadata(item.Elts[6]), "metadata_expression": raw(item.Elts[6]),
				"initial_parsed_labels": map[string]string{},
				"source_start":          s.SourceStart, "source_end": s.SourceEnd, "sha256": s.SHA256, "raw": s.Raw,
			})
		}
	}
	require(len(rows) == 16, "missing JSON parse table rows")
	return rows
}

type load struct {
	Labels   map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Line     string            `json:"line"`
	Start    int               `json:"start"`
	Every    int               `json:"every"`
	Count    int               `json:"count"`
	Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	selection
}
type series struct {
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Values []string          `json:"values"`
	selection
}
type entry struct {
	Labels    map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Line      string            `json:"line"`
	Timestamp int               `json:"timestamp"`
	Metadata  map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	Parsed    map[string]string `json:"parsed"`
	selection
}
type engineCase struct {
	Query           string   `json:"query"`
	ParserForm      string   `json:"parser_form"`
	Mode            string   `json:"mode"`
	Start           int      `json:"start"`
	End             int      `json:"end"`
	Step            int      `json:"step"`
	Direction       string   `json:"direction,omitempty"`
	Outcome         string   `json:"outcome"`
	Reject          string   `json:"reject,omitempty"`
	Expected        []series `json:"expected"`
	ExpectedEntries []entry  `json:"expected_entries"`
	selection
}
type fixture struct {
	Loads []load       `json:"loads"`
	Cases []engineCase `json:"cases"`
	selection
}

var goString = "(?:\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"|`[^`]*`)"
var labelPair = regexp.MustCompile(`^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(` + goString + `)`)

func labelText(text string) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for text = strings.TrimSpace(text); text != ""; text = strings.TrimSpace(text) {
		m := labelPair.FindStringSubmatch(text)
		require(m != nil, "unexpected label text: "+text)
		_, exists := out[m[1]]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label text")
		out[m[1]] = unquote(m[2])
		text = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(text[len(m[0]):], ","))
	}
	return out
}

// Match the pinned logqltest splitQuoted/stripComment, not Go string decoding:
// engine log messages preserve bytes between delimiters without unescaping.
func engineLine(quoted string) string {
	require(len(quoted) >= 2 && quoted[0] == quoted[len(quoted)-1] && (quoted[0] == '`' || quoted[0] == '"'), "invalid engine line")
	line := quoted[1 : len(quoted)-1]
	require(!strings.ContainsRune(line, rune(quoted[0])), "embedded engine quote unsupported")
	return line
}
func stripComment(line string) string {
	var quote byte
	for i := 0; i < len(line); i++ {
		c := line[i]
		switch {
		case quote != 0:
			if c == quote {
				quote = 0
			}
		case c == '"' || c == '`':
			quote = c
		case c == '#':
			return strings.TrimRight(line[:i], " \t")
		}
	}
	return line
}
func extractEngine(data []byte) []fixture {
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	loadRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+(` + goString + `)\s+@ (\d+)s(?: \[repeat every (\d+)s for (\d+)\])?(?: \[metadata (.*)\])?$`)
	instantRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval instant at (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	rangeRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval range from (\d+)s to (\d+)s step (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	selectRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval select from (\d+)(?:s)? to (\d+)s (forward|backward) (.+)$`)
	resultRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+([\d_ ]+)$`)
	entryRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+(` + goString + `) @ (\d+)s(?: \[metadata (.*?)\])?(?: \[parsed (.*?)\])?$`)
	fixtures := []fixture{}
	var current *fixture
	var evaluation *engineCase
	finishCase := func() {
		if evaluation == nil {
			return
		}
		switch evaluation.Outcome {
		case "entries":
			require(evaluation.Mode == "select" && len(evaluation.ExpectedEntries) > 0 && len(evaluation.Expected) == 0, "missing select expectation")
		case "series":
			require(evaluation.Mode != "select" && len(evaluation.Expected) > 0 && len(evaluation.ExpectedEntries) == 0, "missing metric expectation")
			points := 1
			if evaluation.Mode == "range" {
				require(evaluation.Step > 0 && (evaluation.End-evaluation.Start)%evaluation.Step == 0, "invalid range geometry")
				points += (evaluation.End - evaluation.Start) / evaluation.Step
			}
			for _, series := range evaluation.Expected {
				require(len(series.Values) == points, "incorrect expected point count")
			}
		case "reject":
			require(evaluation.Reject != "" && len(evaluation.Expected) == 0 && len(evaluation.ExpectedEntries) == 0, "contradictory rejection")
		default:
			panic("unexpected outcome")
		}
		evaluation.selection = selectLines(data, evaluation.SourceStart, evaluation.SourceEnd, "complete evaluation and exact oracle")
		current.Cases = append(current.Cases, *evaluation)
		current.SourceEnd = evaluation.SourceEnd
		evaluation = nil
	}
	finishFixture := func() {
		finishCase()
		if current != nil {
			require(len(current.Loads) > 0 && len(current.Cases) > 0, "incomplete fixture")
			current.selection = selectLines(data, current.SourceStart, current.SourceEnd, "complete clear/load/evaluation fixture")
			fixtures = append(fixtures, *current)
			current = nil
		}
	}
	// Complete requested block only, never the explicit-path grammar block at 283.
	for lineNo := 115; lineNo <= 281; lineNo++ {
		text := strings.TrimSpace(stripComment(lines[lineNo-1]))
		if text == "" {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case text == "clear":
			finishFixture()
			current = &fixture{selection: selection{SourceStart: lineNo}}
		case text == "load":
			require(current != nil && len(current.Loads) == 0, "unexpected load directive")
		case strings.HasPrefix(text, "eval "):
			finishCase()
			require(current != nil && len(current.Loads) > 0, "evaluation without loads")
			evaluation = &engineCase{ParserForm: "parse_all", Expected: []series{}, ExpectedEntries: []entry{}, selection: selection{SourceStart: lineNo, SourceEnd: lineNo}}
			if m := instantRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Query = "instant", "series", number(m[1]), number(m[1]), m[2]
			} else if m := rangeRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Step, evaluation.Query = "range", "series", number(m[1]), number(m[2]), number(m[3]), m[4]
			} else if m := selectRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Direction, evaluation.Query = "select", "entries", number(m[1]), number(m[2]), m[3], m[4]
			} else {
				panic("unexpected evaluation: " + text)
			}
			if lineNo == 169 {
				require(evaluation.Query == `count_over_time({app="a"} | json sl, md, sm, tri [1m])`, "unexpected in-block expression control")
				evaluation.ParserForm = "explicit_fields"
			} else {
				require(strings.Contains(evaluation.Query, "| json [") || strings.Contains(evaluation.Query, "| json |"), "unexpected non-plain JSON query")
			}
		case evaluation != nil:
			require(evaluation.Outcome != "reject", "expectation after terminal outcome")
			evaluation.SourceEnd = lineNo
			if strings.HasPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ") {
				evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Reject = "reject", strings.TrimPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ")
			} else if evaluation.Mode == "select" {
				m := entryRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
				require(m != nil, "unexpected categorized expectation: "+text)
				evaluation.ExpectedEntries = append(evaluation.ExpectedEntries, entry{labelText(m[1]), engineLine(m[2]), number(m[3]), labelText(m[4]), labelText(m[5]), selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "categorized select oracle")})
			} else {
				m := resultRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
				require(m != nil, "unexpected metric oracle: "+text)
				evaluation.Expected = append(evaluation.Expected, series{labelText(m[1]), strings.Fields(m[2]), selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "exact metric series oracle")})
			}
		default:
			require(current != nil, "load without clear")
			m := loadRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
			require(m != nil, "unexpected load: "+text)
			row := load{Labels: labelText(m[1]), Line: engineLine(m[2]), Start: number(m[3]), Count: 1, Metadata: labelText(m[6]), selection: selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "complete load row, including inline comment")}
			if m[4] != "" {
				row.Every, row.Count = number(m[4]), number(m[5])
			}
			current.Loads = append(current.Loads, row)
		}
	}
	finishFixture()
	return fixtures
}

func main() {
	require(len(os.Args) == 3, "usage: json-parser-producer parser_test.go parsers.logqltest")
	parserData, parserSource := loadSource(os.Args[1], parserPath, "346b91ced2d38e51d8cf7fd8acb3335ea5796e9286fd901b45dd625c0b3634ff")
	engineData, engineSource := loadSource(os.Args[2], enginePath, "07d63941842085ca40bbc3944884377e802df38ede67027b9702594e840114ea")
	parserSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(parserData, 13, 247, "complete Test_jsonParser_Parse declaration, schema and all 16 table rows"),
		selectLines(parserData, 248, 273, "inert harness provenance: path tracking, hints, metadata, input immutability and flat label assertions"),
	}
	engineSource.Selections = []selection{selectLines(engineData, 115, 281, "complete requested JSON block, including comments, whitespace and the in-block expression control at 169")}
	rows, fixtures := extractTable(parserData), extractEngine(engineData)
	counts := map[string]int{
		"parse_rows": len(rows), "table_rows": len(rows), "table_evaluations": len(rows), "table_hinted_rows": 0,
		"table_unhinted_rows": 0, "table_metadata_rows": 0, "table_json_path_maps": len(rows), "table_json_path_entries": 0,
		"engine_fixtures": len(fixtures), "engine_sparse_slots": 0, "engine_empty_evaluations": 0,
	}
	for _, row := range rows {
		if row["hinted"].(bool) {
			counts["table_hinted_rows"]++
		} else {
			counts["table_unhinted_rows"]++
		}
		if len(row["structured_metadata"].(map[string]string)) > 0 {
			counts["table_metadata_rows"]++
		}
		counts["table_json_path_entries"] += len(row["want_json_path"].(map[string][]string))
	}
	for _, fixture := range fixtures {
		counts["engine_load_rows"] += len(fixture.Loads)
		for _, load := range fixture.Loads {
			counts["engine_loaded_entries"] += load.Count
			if len(load.Metadata) > 0 {
				counts["engine_metadata_load_rows"]++
			}
		}
		for _, row := range fixture.Cases {
			counts["engine_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_"+row.Mode+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_"+row.Outcome+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_"+row.ParserForm+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_expected_series"] += len(row.Expected)
			counts["engine_expected_entries"] += len(row.ExpectedEntries)
			for _, series := range row.Expected {
				for _, value := range series.Values {
					if value == "_" {
						counts["engine_sparse_slots"]++
					} else {
						counts["engine_numeric_slots"]++
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	counts["total_evaluations"] = counts["table_evaluations"] + counts["engine_evaluations"]
	for key, want := range map[string]int{
		"parse_rows": 16, "table_hinted_rows": 1, "table_unhinted_rows": 15, "table_metadata_rows": 1,
		"engine_fixtures": 7, "engine_load_rows": 20, "engine_loaded_entries": 38, "engine_metadata_load_rows": 9,
		"engine_evaluations": 42, "engine_instant_evaluations": 32, "engine_range_evaluations": 9, "engine_select_evaluations": 1,
		"engine_series_evaluations": 33, "engine_entries_evaluations": 1, "engine_reject_evaluations": 8, "engine_empty_evaluations": 0,
		"engine_parse_all_evaluations": 41, "engine_explicit_fields_evaluations": 1,
		"engine_expected_series": 37, "engine_expected_entries": 1, "engine_numeric_slots": 47, "engine_sparse_slots": 2, "total_evaluations": 58,
	} {
		require(counts[key] == want, "incorrect count: "+key)
	}
	artifact := map[string]any{
		"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
		"attribution": "Grafana Labs contributors; extraction adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28. See adjacent LICENSE. No upstream runtime implementation is included.",
		"provenance": map[string]any{
			"repository": "https://github.com/grafana/loki", "producer": "test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/json-parser-producer.go.txt",
			"method":                "Standard-library Go AST plus bounded logqltest source extraction, following logfmt-ownership-producer.go.txt; no runtime evaluation. Both complete source SHA-256 values must match before extraction or output.",
			"sources":               []source{parserSource, engineSource},
			"range_hash_convention": "SHA-256 of exact inclusive complete source lines, including the final newline. All raw fields preserve original bytes, indentation, comments and spelling.",
		},
		"replay": map[string]any{
			"requirements":        "Normal replay reads committed JSON using Elixir/Rust JSON only, without Go, network or expectation generation. The producer is optional provenance tooling, not a build/test dependency.",
			"table":               "Each table row is one upstream evaluation (not strict/non-strict variants). base_labels is the initial stream owner; structured_metadata is attached after builder reset and before parsing; initial_parsed_labels={} records no preexisting parsed labels. want is the exact flat LabelsResult().Labels() assertion, NOT a categorized oracle. Preserve input line bytes and verify input immutability if replaying a mutable parser. metadata_expression preserves original nil versus a Go map; nil metadata has the same empty owner represented by {} for replay.",
			"hints":               "hint_expression is inert original Go source. The single hinted row, errors hints (197-207), uses NewParserHint([]string{\"__error__\"}, nil, false, true, \"\"); the other 15 use NoParserHints(). Pulse's public API does not expose this hint object. An ordinary unhinted JSON-stage replay can compare its frozen error oracle, but cannot claim to exercise the upstream hinted builder, extraction selection or short-circuit behavior. Do not discard the row or rewrite want to accommodate missing hint support.",
			"json_paths":          "want_json_path and json_path_expression preserve all original expected maps as inert provenance. Upstream NewJSONParser(true) tracks paths; its harness only checks keys in nonempty maps and does not assert absence of other paths. Pulse's public API exposes no path map: ordinary replay compares want, not these internal maps, and makes no path-tracking claim.",
			"engine":              "All times, steps and repeat intervals are integer seconds relative to upstream epoch 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (logqltest/parser.go:19-25). Replay may shift an entire fixture to a deterministic retained epoch while preserving every relative timestamp. Repeat count includes the first entry: expand start+i*every for i=0..count-1 (parser.go:129-134). Preserve load order, noise and metadata; never flatten metadata into stream labels. Engine log text is the raw content between its delimiters (no unescaping), unlike Go AST table strings. Reset only on clear, not between cases.",
			"metrics":             "mode=instant has equal start/end and step=0; mode=range has its explicit step. outcome=series uses exact combined label maps and original numeric-string slots at start+i*step. An underscore means a missing point, never zero or an omitted whole series. No selected case explicitly expects an empty result. outcome=reject has the exact upstream expected message substring in reject (JSONParserErr), not a full HTTP error body. Preserve complete __error_details__ strings in series/entry labels, including original conversion-error text. Internal SampleExtractionErr overriding JSONParserErr and the ordinary metadata key __preserve_error__ are unmodified source expectations, not Pulse-derived behavior.",
			"select":              "mode=select uses direction, start/end and step=0. outcome=entries uses expected_entries: labels is the stream owner only; metadata and parsed are separate per-entry owners. Missing clauses become empty maps. Compare all categories, input text and relative timestamp, following logqltest/runner.go:490-545. Empty expected/expected_entries arrays are mode placeholders, NOT expect-empty assertions.",
			"in_block_expression": "Keep the complete ownership fixture at 159-170: its third evaluation at 169-170 is an explicit-fields json sl, md, sm, tri control, marked parser_form=explicit_fields. The other 41 engine cases are parser_form=parse_all. This preserves the complete requested fixture without importing the later explicit-path grammar block at 283 onward.",
		},
		"limitations": []string{
			"Frozen upstream table/engine oracles only: this producer never runs Loki or Pulse. Counts are selected upstream evaluations, not passing Pulse tests, exact hinted/path-tracking replay, or HTTP/Parquet/S3/client/deployment/capacity acceptance.",
			"Unit selection 13-247 is the entire Test_jsonParser_Parse table, not its whole function; 248-273 is retained separately as inert harness provenance. All 16 rows remain, including the nested-bad-key line's trailing quote, whitespace/empty keys, replacement rune, malformed input, hints and structured-metadata collision. Their original expectations must not be sanitized or weakened.",
			"Engine selection 115-281 starts with a blank separator; the JSON heading is actually 116 and first clear is 117. All seven fixtures are complete and end at oracle 281. The in-block explicit-fields control at 169 is included and counted separately; no source from the explicit-path grammar block beginning 283 is included.",
			"JSON path maps and hinted unit-row state have no direct public-API equivalent and remain explicitly limited provenance. This extraction includes no runtime/HTTP harness and makes no general JSON parser, repeated-parser, hint, full LogQL or error-envelope parity claim.",
		},
		"counts": counts, "parse_cases": rows, "fixtures": fixtures,
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(enc.Encode(artifact))
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "16 table rows (15 unhinted, 1 hinted); 7 engine fixtures / 20 loads / 38 entries / 42 evaluations (32 instant, 9 range, 1 select; 8 rejections); 58 upstream evaluations total")
}
